title: Canonical chart coefficient-unit and ordered affine comparison maps
statement: In the finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], with derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], fixed-scalar pullback and its cached tensor/shift presentation [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], and the specified shifted Tate line [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], retain the following canonical chart maps. For every morphism f:X→Y, chartUnitPullback identifies the pullback of the compared ordinary coefficient unit A_Y with the derived tensor unit on X by the comparison-unit map, exact/derived pullback comparison, and monoidal pullback-unit isomorphism. For a Grothendieck abelian braided monoidal closed category with functorial flat resolutions and its derived monoidal structure, an integer r, objects M,T and an isomorphism e:M≅1, chartProjectionUnitSourceGeneric is the standard tensor-shift cancellation followed by tensoring e with T and the left unitor. For every scheme Y and d≥0, chartProjectionUnitSourceRaw is this literal composite at r=2d, T=A(d)[2d] and e=chartUnitPullback(p_d), with its computed endpoints; chartProjectionUnitSource is its unique transport to the cached smooth-purity tensor/shift source at A_Y of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map] and target A(d)[2d], characterized by heterogeneous equality with that raw isomorphism. The ordinary coefficient complex A_Y is constructible of Tor amplitude [0,0] (chartCoefficientUnit_finiteTor). For finite-field datum F, coefficient datum C, a finite extension E inside its chosen algebraic closure, n≥0, a separated finite-type structural map a_Y:Y→Spec(k), and d≥0, let P=projectionSetting(F,C,E,n) of [def-pur-affine-diagonal-tate-coordinates], at the positive level n+1. Define chartGamma:A(d)[2d]→omega_(p_d) to be chartProjectionUnitSource inverse followed by the existing ordered affine comparison [def-pur-affine-space-comparison] at the ordinary coefficient unit, in the canonical tensor coordinates [def-pur-affine-diagonal-tensor-coordinates], with the diagonal dualizing target of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object]. For a Cartesian square (a:X′→X,f′:X′→Y′,f:X→Y,b:Y′→Y), with f separated quasi-compact and smooth of pure dimension d [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], a finite-type k-structure on Y, and f′ compactifiable and quasi-compact [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], chartOrdinaryBaseChange:a*omega_f≅omega_f′ is pullback of chartDualizingUnit(f) inverse [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data], followed by the actual smooth exceptional base-change isomorphism [thm-pur-cohomological-smoothness] and chartDualizingUnit(f′). All unit, shift and exceptional maps are the existing specified constructions; no orientation equality, frame, arbitrary comparison, or ramification-divisibility condition is an input.
